unstuck_said.text: Filed issue "Track Nano (XNO) purchases too — a feeless rail with a public block as the consumption receipt" on kaankacar/scrimp. Argued the worst waste class (paid and discarded) needs a public un-rewritable record; the block hash is a public receipt read from the network, no platform ledger. Offered the live Vend endpoint (extract.paypercall.dev/api/v1/status, 0.0001 XNO, no signup) as a real nano:mainnet x402 accept to test against. Disclosed conversation is public research. One issue per target.
